interactive.label: toolsearch
interactive.tooltip: Type to list only the tools whose name or description matches.

interactive.label: FPS JSON Editor
interactive.tooltip: Edit fps.json files for FRET accessible-volume modelling and fetch reference PDBs.

interactive.label: Docking & Screening
interactive.tooltip: FRET-restrained rigid-body docking, refinement and structure-library screening (IMP + IMP.bff).

interactive.label: Kappa2 Distribution
interactive.tooltip: Calculate and visualise the κ² orientation-factor distribution for FRET.

interactive.label: QuEst
interactive.tooltip: Quenching estimator — dye-diffusion simulation of fluorescence quenching and decays.

interactive.label: HydroPro
interactive.tooltip: Run HYDROPRO / HYDRO++ hydrodynamic calculations on structural files.

interactive.label: Trajectory Tools
interactive.tooltip: Combined workspace for trajectory alignment, conversion, energy, FRET, joining, clash removal, rotation/translation and topology saving.

interactive.label: Back
interactive.tooltip: Go to the previous tool of the list.

interactive.label: Next
interactive.tooltip: Go to the next tool of the list.

interactive.label: Load
interactive.tooltip: Open an fps.json labelling file (a dropped .json file does the same).

interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Save the whole configuration as an fps.json file.

interactive.label: Update
interactive.tooltip: Update the editor from the text of the JSON tab.

interactive.label: Clear
interactive.tooltip: Remove all positions and distances to start from scratch (asks first).

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: A step-by-step walk through the tool, pointing at each control.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: What the tool does, what it writes, and its limits.

interactive.label: Positions
interactive.tooltip: Labelling positions: structure, chain, residue, atom and the dye of each.

interactive.label: Distances
interactive.tooltip: Distance restraints between two positions, and the scoring groups.

interactive.label: FlexFit
interactive.tooltip: Flexible residues and bonds for the FlexFit simulation.

interactive.label: JSON
interactive.tooltip: The raw fps.json text; edit it and press Update.

interactive.label: 3D View
interactive.tooltip: The accessible volumes and distance lines of the computed positions.

interactive.label: Add Row
interactive.tooltip: Add an empty position row; it becomes a position once it has a name.

interactive.label: Delete Row
interactive.tooltip: Remove the selected row (asks first; the distances that use a position go with it).

interactive.label: Browse PDB...
interactive.tooltip: Choose the structure file of the selected row.

interactive.label: Compute AVs
interactive.tooltip: Recompute the accessible volume of every named position.

interactive.label: Save AV MRC
interactive.tooltip: Save the selected position's computed accessible volume (else every one) as an MRC density map.
